summary: Source Workbench administrative Job/Result Save and Delete share a session-owned in-flight reservation by parent job ID, published before the React transition and retained through follow-up reads. Duplicate or conflicting callbacks are not queued. Paired-record views and sidebar remount retain protection while other records, editing, navigation and export remain available. Deferred task/result rows filter against current identities so confirmed deletion cannot remain visible while refresh waits. Fourteen added mocked-service Chromium controls and 21 added frontend controls verify scoped behavior. This is not backend locking, cross-client serialization, late-message ownership, installed WebView, remote, power-loss, ambiguous-write, authenticated provenance or exactly-once qualification. No persistent cache, snapshot, backup, retry queue, production Node dependency or operational-grade promotion is added.

required_text: the reservation must publish before React starts a transition
synchronous duplicate activation must not replay a record write
remount cannot replay a pending write
Effect remount restores pending identities without starting another operation.
This change does not add late-message ownership fencing
